name: A Valkyrie and a Songbird
source:
May and Ariel were once the center of each other's worlds. Then May left without a word, shattering Ariel. Now she's back, turning Ariel's world upside down once more.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
